protocol.inventory: exact saved primary local-grid point_components per prior; no new coordinates
protocol.frequency: same shortlist/CFO fit once per point and shared by both reception variants
protocol.selection: minimum D_plus_geometry within each variant on identical points
protocol.truth_access: local-grid-distances is read only to verify the source-grid artifact hash; no distance/error/reference fields choose points or scores

topology_receipt.rule: Exclude every whole track containing a source anchor used more than once; all train and reserve observations audited; no score, signal strength, receiver position, or satellite criteria.
